# DR-005 · Capability carries no projected dimensions

*2026-09-02*

Rejected a read/write dimension on `Capability`. What a Capability can change is
answered fully by its application to Securables via Permissions, so encoding it on
the Capability is either lossy or a restatement of the whole space. Granularity
comes from the product of the two axes.

**Options considered.**

- _A read/write dimension on Capability_ — rejected. What a Capability can change is answered fully by applying it to Securables through Permissions, so encoding it on the Capability is either lossy or a restatement of the whole space.
- _Capability stays securable-free_ — chosen. Granularity comes from the product of the two axes, and keeping them independent is what makes the product expressive.

**What would falsify this.** A Capability whose meaning cannot be recovered from any Permission naming it.
